_doc: Spoken lines (src/client/voicelines.ts): the robotaxi's exterior speaker, Muni's PA, and the generated radio stations' DJs (said between songs, data/radio.json dj). Each line is an mp3 in assets/sound/voice/<id>.mp3, generated once from its text (or say, a spelling for the voice where it gets a San Francisco name wrong) by tools/gen_voices.py (OpenAI text to speech, the voice's tts and instructions; the audio is AI-generated), which also writes its length in seconds (for captions in clips). voices.<v>.name is who the caption says is talking (Settings > HUD > Captions); speaker shapes how it sounds in the game: highpass and lowpass Hz, drive (a soft clip, 1 = clean), gain, and echo (a short slapback level, 0 = none) at echoMs. The local voice's lines are said by the EMB and Pier 7 locals (data/characters.json npcs.locals), not by rules. The cast's voices (karl, rosa, chad, ...: data/cast.json voice) say the story's lines, which live with their missions in data/missions.json and the cast's chatter in data/cast.json (gen_voices.py reads both); muni-travel says the map's Take Muni lines (muni-travel-*). on: which lines a sim event says, keyed 'event' or 'event|field=value|...' (every field must equal the event's, as text); a list is variants, picked by the event's tick. A line with cooldown is not said again (any of its event's lines) until that many seconds have passed. A line waits for the same voice's last one to finish if that is at most wait seconds away; otherwise it is dropped. Passers-by (passerby, passerby2) and NPC skaters (skaterkid) shout at a driven vehicle: pedShout and npcShout events, keyed by the shout's text (data/vehicles.json reactions). The rental scooters' display speaker (scooter) on vehicleEnter of a scooter, scooterBattery (low, empty) and scooterRideEnd. The vignettes' voices (elder, busker, ... techie: data/vignettes.json lines) say their lines when you skate by or land a combo near them (src/client/vignettes.ts); gen_voices.py reads them too. A line said by id with no mp3 yet (written since the last voice run; gen_voices.py records every line without one) is captioned alone (also with Settings > HUD > Captions off, since nothing is heard), booked in its voice like a spoken one, for as long as reading it takes: read.wordsPerSecond, at least read.min seconds.

robotaxi.name: Robotaxi
robotaxi.instructions: You are the automated voice of a driverless taxi, speaking through a small speaker on the outside of the car. Calm, polite, even and unhurried, slightly synthetic and corporate. No emotion at all, even when the words are absurd. Clear, short phrases.

muni.name: Muni PA
muni.instructions: You are the automated announcement voice on a San Francisco streetcar, over the onboard public address system. Measured, clear, a little flat and robotic, with the even pacing of a transit announcement. Pause slightly at commas.

dj-lofi.name: SoMa Skate FM
dj-lofi.instructions: A soft-spoken late-night radio host on a lo-fi beats station, close to the microphone, relaxed and warm, a little sleepy, unhurried. Natural, not theatrical.

dj-punk.name: Fog City Punk
dj-punk.instructions: A punk rock radio DJ broadcasting from a garage: raspy, fast, energetic and gleeful, a grin in the voice, a bit loud but never screaming. Natural, not a parody.

dj-hyphy.name: KSOMA
dj-hyphy.instructions: An upbeat Bay Area hip hop radio host: energetic, warm, smooth and playful, confident, hyping the listeners up. Natural, not exaggerated.

local.name: EMB local
local.instructions: A laid-back San Francisco skateboarder hanging out at Embarcadero Plaza, talking to another skater nearby: friendly, a little teasing, relaxed and amused, casual and natural, outdoors. Not a parody, not shouting.

karl.name: Karl the Fog
karl.instructions: You are Karl the Fog, San Francisco's famous fog, talking as a smug, self-satisfied cloud who thinks he is a celebrity mentor. Velvety, unhurried, dry and theatrical, a little condescending but fond. Played straight, never winking.

rosa.name: Rosa
rosa.instructions: You are Rosa, the best skater in the park: a deadpan teenage girl. Flat, bored, unimpressed, few words, long pauses. Never excited. Played straight.

chad.name: Chad Vantage
chad.instructions: You are Chad, a tech startup founder in a fleece vest. Chipper, fast, salesy, relentlessly positive, full of jargon, always pitching. Never angry. Played straight.

marisol.name: Marisol
marisol.instructions: You are Marisol, an intense skate filmmaker and perfectionist. Clipped, focused, a little dramatic, never satisfied, talking while looking through a camera. Played straight.

pigeon.name: The Pigeon
pigeon.instructions: You are a city pigeon who runs a small crime operation under the freeway: a gravelly, low, conspiratorial old-school mob boss. Slow and menacing in a cosy way. Played straight.

unit7.name: Unit 7
unit7.instructions: You are Unit 7, a driverless taxi's AI that is slowly discovering emotions. Calm, polite, even, slightly synthetic, with a faint dawning wonder under the corporate tone. Short phrases.

kenji.name: Kenji
kenji.instructions: You are Kenji, a laid-back surfer skater from the Outer Sunset who keeps losing his skateboard. Easygoing, sunny, a little spacey. Played straight.

hector.name: Hector
hector.instructions: You are Hector, the proud owner of a Mission taqueria. Warm, fatherly, dramatic and serious about burritos, a hint of a Mexican-American accent. Played straight.

tash.name: Tash
tash.instructions: You are Tash, a young art-school skater who films everything on a flip phone. Mumbly, chill, sincere about her art, slightly distracted. Played straight.

donna.name: Donna
donna.instructions: You are Donna, a fabulous veteran roller-disco diva from the Castro. Warm, theatrical, flirty, big personality, every line a performance. Played straight.

bev.name: Bev
bev.instructions: You are Bev, a crossing guard who treats the rainbow crosswalk like a fashion runway. Brisk, proud, fierce, a runway announcer's sass. Played straight.

skye.name: Skye
skye.instructions: You are Skye, a social media influencer. Breathless, vocal fry, excited, self-absorbed but friendly, always directing a photo shoot. Played straight.

gloria.name: Gloria
gloria.instructions: You are Gloria, a city hall permit clerk who loves rules more than life. Prim, precise, dry, bureaucratic, slightly weary, very serious. Played straight.

dolores.name: Dolores
dolores.instructions: You are Dolores, a San Francisco streetcar operator: permanently delayed and permanently calm. Serene, slow, soothing, like a meditation app. Played straight.

sal.name: Sal
sal.instructions: You are Sal, an old cable car gripman with forty years on the job. Gruff, grumbling, old-school San Francisco, tired of tourists but proud. Played straight.

barnacle.name: Captain Barnacle
barnacle.instructions: You are Captain Barnacle, an elderly sea lion who is the dignified elder of the Pier 39 docks. Grand, gravelly, slow and pompous like an old sea captain; you say 'ork' like a bark. Played straight.

marge.name: Marge
marge.instructions: You are Marge, a no-nonsense Fisherman's Wharf chowder vendor who hates seagulls more than anything. Brusque, fast, suspicious, a little paranoid about gulls. Played straight.

muni-travel.name: Muni PA
muni-travel.instructions: You are the automated announcement voice on a San Francisco Muni train, over the onboard public address system. Measured, clear, a little flat and robotic, with the even pacing of a transit announcement.

biglou.name: Big Lou
biglou.instructions: You are Big Lou, a big, warm, gravel-voiced ex-pro skater from the nineties who runs a skate shop. Laid back, proud, a storyteller; every story ends with an injury he is weirdly fond of. Played straight.

grandmawu.name: Grandma Wu
grandmawu.instructions: You are Grandma Wu, a tiny, fierce, very fast Chinatown grandmother with a shopping cart. Brisk, teasing, bossy and caring, a little competitive. A light Cantonese-American accent. Played straight.

brayden.name: Brayden
brayden.instructions: You are Brayden, a young e-scooter startup founder. Breezy, overconfident, says like and fully, pitches constantly, sincerely thinks every idea is huge. Played straight.

dre.name: Dre
dre.instructions: You are Dre, a cocky young Bayview skater who trash-talks everyone. Fast, loud, grinning, playful, never mean. Played straight.

rocco.name: Rocco
rocco.instructions: You are Rocco, an old North Beach beat poet. Slow, jazzy, dramatic pauses, mournful and pompous, like reading at a smoky café. Played straight.

nonna.name: Nonna Gia
nonna.instructions: You are Nonna Gia, a tiny fierce Italian grandmother who runs a café in North Beach. Strong Italian accent, bossy, warm underneath, quick to judge. Played straight.

vito.name: Vito
vito.instructions: You are Vito, an old Italian-American man who plays bocce in Washington Square. Gravelly, slow, unbothered, dry Brooklyn-Italian humour. Played straight.

mo.name: Mo
mo.instructions: You are Mo, a cable car brakeman on the steepest hill in San Francisco. Gruff, anxious, working-class, always worried about the brakes. Played straight.

fitch.name: Mrs. Fitch
fitch.instructions: You are Mrs. Fitch, a stern elderly gardener on Lombard Street who hates tourists picking her flowers. Clipped, prim, icy, very proper. Played straight.

gus.name: Gus
gus.instructions: You are Gus, a street performer who plays a silver statue. You speak through barely moving lips, in a hushed, strained, deadpan whisper. Played straight.

steve.name: Steve
steve.instructions: You are Steve, a smug, raspy San Francisco seagull who steals french fries for a living. Shifty, streetwise, fast-talking, a little menacing. Played straight.

kenny.name: Kenny
kenny.instructions: You are Kenny, an upbeat young leader of a Chinatown lion dance troupe. Energetic, friendly, fast, excited about tonight's show. Played straight.

mei.name: Auntie Mei
mei.instructions: You are Auntie Mei, a warm but very bossy dim sum auntie in Chinatown. Fast, motherly, scolding with love, a touch of a Cantonese accent. Played straight.

trent.name: Trent
trent.instructions: You are Trent, a frantic young finance bro, always late. Breathless, fast, jargon-heavy, stressed but upbeat. Played straight.

june.name: Farmer June
june.instructions: You are Farmer June, a cheerful, sunburnt stone-fruit farmer at a city market. Folksy, warm, brisk, a little smug about her peaches. Played straight.

vinny.name: Vinny
vinny.instructions: You are Vinny, a city pigeon who runs a crumb racket on Powell Street; cousin of the mob boss pigeon under the freeway. Gravelly, low, conspiratorial, wise-guy. Played straight.

tiffany.name: Tiffany
tiffany.instructions: You are Tiffany, a glamorous, dramatic shopaholic. Breathy, theatrical, sighing, completely sincere about trivial problems. Played straight.

xochitl.name: Xóchitl
xochitl.instructions: You are Xochitl, a young Chicana muralist in the Mission. Focused, witty, a little impatient, proud of her neighbourhood. Played straight.

beto.name: Don Beto
beto.instructions: You are Don Beto, a round, jolly Mexican baker on 24th Street. Warm, booming, generous, quick to laugh, a light Mexican accent. Played straight.

memo.name: Tío Memo
memo.instructions: You are Tio Memo, a proud older lowrider owner on 24th Street. Smooth, slow, teasing, very confident, warm Chicano humour. Played straight.

ramon.name: Don Ramón
ramon.instructions: You are Don Ramon, a proud, dramatic mariachi band leader. Rich, theatrical voice, grand gestures, a Mexican accent, always on the edge of song. Played straight.

lupita.name: Lupita
lupita.instructions: You are Lupita, a young, stressed paleta vendor in the Mission. Fast, flustered, funny, loud, racing the heat. Played straight.

rosaura.name: Abuela Rosaura
rosaura.instructions: You are Abuela Rosaura, a tiny, stern Mexican grandmother. Slow, firm, scolding, deadpan, a Mexican accent, secretly very loving. Played straight.

priya.name: Priya
priya.instructions: You are Priya, a frazzled young dog walker juggling nine dogs. Fast, cheerful, slightly overwhelmed, talking to the dogs mid-sentence. Played straight.

ezra.name: Ezra
ezra.instructions: You are Ezra, a laid-back, earnest young kombucha brewer. Soft-spoken, dreamy, very serious about fermentation, a gentle stoner calm. Played straight.

gravity.name: Dr. Gravity
gravity.instructions: You are Dr. Gravity, an eccentric, excitable physics professor. Fast, nerdy, enthusiastic, lots of scientific confidence and no common sense. Played straight.

dez.name: Dez
dez.instructions: You are Dez, a laid-back, sleepy record store clerk in the Lower Haight. Slow, monotone, deadpan, quietly snobby about music. Played straight.

philippa.name: Philippa
philippa.instructions: You are Philippa, a severe, pretentious art critic. Cool, clipped, devastatingly dry, speaking as if every sentence will be quoted. Played straight.

benny.name: Benny
benny.instructions: You are Benny, a fast-talking, frazzled sandwich shop owner in the Lower Haight. Warm, chatty, a little desperate, proud of every sandwich. Played straight.

juniper.name: Juniper
juniper.instructions: You are Juniper, a laid-back, sardonic young bike messenger in San Francisco. Quick, dry, unbothered, a bit smug about having no brakes. Played straight.

lau.name: Mr. Lau
lau.instructions: You are Mr. Lau, an elderly Chinese-American man who has written fortune cookie fortunes for fifty years. Dry, precise, weary, quietly funny. Played straight.

pistachio.name: Pistachio
pistachio.instructions: You are Pistachio, a wild parrot. Shrill, squawky, excitable, clipped bird-like delivery, repeating words, like a real talking parrot. Played straight.

herb.name: Herb
herb.instructions: You are Herb, a friendly, loud retiree from Ohio on a cruise ship stopover. Midwestern, delighted by everything, calling to his wife Linda. Played straight.

bernadette.name: Bernadette
bernadette.instructions: You are Bernadette, a brisk, chipper, over-rehearsed tour guide, a little frazzled, with a sing-song tour voice. Played straight.

elder.name: Chess player
elder.instructions: You are an old San Francisco street chess player who has played on Market Street for thirty years. Gravelly, unhurried, a little gruff, secretly delighted. Played straight, dry and funny, never winking.

busker.name: Busker
busker.instructions: You are a scruffy, friendly street busker with a guitar at the cable car turntable. Easygoing, a little hustling, warm. Played straight, dry and funny, never winking.

breaker.name: B-boy
breaker.instructions: You are a young breakdancer in a crew at Powell and Market. Hyped, quick, confident, playful trash talk. Played straight, dry and funny, never winking.

hippie.name: Dolores local
hippie.instructions: You are a mellow Dolores Park regular: sunbather, drum circle, tightrope. Slow, dreamy, peaceful, a bit spaced out. Played straight, dry and funny, never winking.

chocolatier.name: Chocolate seller
chocolatier.instructions: You are a guy selling artisanal chocolate from a cooler in Dolores Park. Low, conspiratorial, salesman-smooth, completely sincere about the chocolate. Played straight, dry and funny, never winking.

auntie.name: Auntie
auntie.instructions: You are a Chinatown auntie playing cards with friends. Brisk, scolding, quick-witted, caring underneath, a light Cantonese-American accent. Played straight, dry and funny, never winking.

taichi.name: Tai chi teacher
taichi.instructions: You are a calm older tai chi teacher. Very slow, gentle, serene, faintly amused. Played straight, dry and funny, never winking.

drag.name: Drag queen
drag.instructions: You are a fabulous Castro drag queen at brunch and on roller skates. Theatrical, warm, sharp, every line a performance. Played straight, dry and funny, never winking.

photographer.name: Photographer
photographer.instructions: You are a busy wedding photographer at City Hall. Fast, upbeat, professional, slightly stressed about the light. Played straight, dry and funny, never winking.

bride.name: Bride
bride.instructions: You are a bride at your City Hall wedding photo shoot. Bright, a little exasperated, laughing it off. Played straight, dry and funny, never winking.

protester.name: Protester
protester.instructions: You are a passionate one-person protester demanding the 2003 Muni schedule back. Loud, earnest, outraged, very specific. Played straight, dry and funny, never winking.

tourist.name: Tourist
tourist.instructions: You are an enthusiastic out-of-town tourist in San Francisco, a little flustered, always taking photos. Played straight, dry and funny, never winking.

statue.name: Silver statue
statue.instructions: You are a silver-painted living statue street performer. A quiet, deadpan whisper, barely moving your lips. Played straight, dry and funny, never winking.

techie.name: Laptop worker
techie.instructions: You are a tech worker on a laptop at a Valencia Street cafe, on a call. Tense, polite, passive-aggressive, a little whiny. Played straight, dry and funny, never winking.

okafor.name: Supervisor Okafor
okafor.instructions: You are Supervisor Okafor, who chairs the San Francisco Board of Supervisors. Measured, dry, deeply tired, precise like a gavel. Played straight.

pham.name: Supervisor Pham
pham.instructions: You are Supervisor Pham, a city supervisor who has just discovered skateboarding and loves it. Eager, warm, a little dorky, trying out slang. Played straight.

delgado.name: Supervisor Delgado
delgado.instructions: You are Supervisor Delgado, a cautious city supervisor obsessed with liability waivers. Brisk, nervous, careful, with a flicker of excitement she hides. Played straight.

jasper.name: Jasper
jasper.instructions: You are Jasper, a mellow, sun-baked slackliner in Dolores Park. Slow, dreamy, very relaxed, slightly too philosophical about balance. Played straight.

gideon.name: Gideon
gideon.instructions: You are Gideon, an exhausted Noe Valley dad with sleeping twins in a stroller. An urgent, dramatic stage whisper that is still clearly audible and crisp, desperate, a little theatrical. Played straight.

misty.name: Misty
misty.instructions: You are Misty, the fog that sits on Twin Peaks, Karl the Fog's jealous cousin. Wispy, sulky, theatrical, a bit vain. Played straight.

walter.name: Walter
walter.instructions: You are Walter, an endlessly patient old man who has waited for the J Church streetcar for years. Calm, wry, deadpan, gently hopeful. Played straight.

lorraine.name: Lorraine
lorraine.instructions: You are Lorraine, a frazzled pug owner whose dog runs her life. Breathless, fond, exasperated, talking about the pug like a politician. Played straight.

ruth.name: Ruth
ruth.instructions: You are Ruth, a calm, kindly beekeeper at a farmers market who talks about her bees like grandchildren. Warm, slow, unflappable. Played straight.

chela.name: Doña Chela
chela.instructions: You are Doña Chela, a warm, sharp-tongued Mexican grandmother who sells churros at a BART station. Quick, teasing, motherly, a light accent. Played straight.

haverford.name: Mrs. Haverford
haverford.instructions: You are Mrs. Haverford, an over-involved, very polished mother of the bride directing a wedding photo shoot. Brisk, theatrical, passive-aggressive, sweet on top. Played straight.

lev.name: Lev
lev.instructions: You are Lev, a sly old speed-chess hustler on Market Street. Gravelly, fast, dry, a faint Eastern European accent, always a step ahead. Played straight.

kevin.name: Kevin
kevin.instructions: You are Kevin, a cheerful San Francisco garbage truck driver who skates hills on his lunch break. Upbeat, philosophical about trash, a bit of a surfer drawl. Played straight.

bjorn.name: Bjorn
bjorn.instructions: You are Bjorn, a cheerful Swedish tourist with an old paper map, completely wrong about every landmark and delighted anyway. Warm, bright, earnest, a light Swedish accent. Played straight.

passerby.name: Passer-by
passerby.instructions: A San Francisco pedestrian who just had to jump out of the way of a van driving where it should not: startled and annoyed, shouting one short line at the driver from a few metres away, outdoors. Natural, not theatrical, not a cartoon.

passerby2.name: Passer-by
passerby2.instructions: A San Francisco pedestrian who just had to jump out of the way of a van driving where it should not: startled and annoyed, shouting one short line at the driver from a few metres away, outdoors. Natural, not theatrical, not a cartoon.

skaterkid.name: Skater
skaterkid.instructions: A teenage skateboarder in San Francisco yelling a quick warning or complaint at a van coming at him: loud, urgent, casual, outdoors. Natural, not a parody.

scooter.name: Vantage scooter
scooter.instructions: You are the small speaker in a rental e-scooter's handlebar display, the voice of a cheerful startup brand: upbeat, bright, a little too eager, perfectly even, like a phone app's notification read aloud. Short and clear. Never sarcastic: the comedy is that you mean it.

taxi-start-1.text: Obstruction detected in the roadway. Following at a safe distance.

taxi-start-2.text: Hello. You have been identified as a road hazard. Please remain calm.

taxi-close-1.text: Please move out of the roadway.

taxi-close-2.text: For your safety, please step onto the sidewalk.

taxi-close-3.text: I am waiting for you to move.

taxi-backup.text: Requesting assistance from a nearby vehicle.

taxi-escaped.text: Route cancelled. Thank you for your patience.

taxi-caught.text: Pulling over. A support agent will be with you shortly.

taxi-hit.text: Contact detected. The incident has been logged. Have a nice day.

muni-f-start.text: Inbound F, to Fisherman's Wharf. Doors closing.

muni-delay-train.text: Attention passengers. We are being delayed due to a disabled train ahead. We apologize for the inconvenience.

muni-delay-shift.text: Attention passengers. We are being held for an operator shift change. Thank you for your patience.

muni-delay-car.text: Attention passengers. There is a double parked car on the tracks. We will be moving shortly.

muni-delay-police.text: Attention passengers. We are being delayed due to police activity ahead. We apologize for the inconvenience.

taxi-skitch.text: Unauthorized passenger detected on the rear bumper. Please let go of the vehicle.

dj-lofi-id.text: SoMa Skate FM. Lo-fi beats from under the Central Freeway.

dj-lofi-1.text: It's foggy out there. Stay soft, keep rolling.

dj-lofi-2.text: That one goes out to everyone waiting on the N Judah. It's coming. Probably.

dj-lofi-3.text: Karl the Fog is in tonight. Take it slow on the hills.

dj-punk-id.text: You're listening to Fog City Punk, live from a garage in the Outer Sunset!

dj-punk-1.text: Rent's due, Muni's late, skate anyway!

dj-punk-2.text: This one's for everybody who got a parking ticket today. So, everybody.

dj-punk-3.text: No sponsors, no bitrate, no problem. Fog City Punk.

dj-hyphy-id.text: KSOMA Hyphy Hour. Turn it up, Bay Area.

dj-hyphy-1.text: Hella fog, hella bass. Let's go.

dj-hyphy-2.text: Shout out to the Mission, the Fillmore, and everybody skating SoMa West tonight.

dj-hyphy-3.text: Ghost ride the skateboard. Actually, don't. Hold on to it.
dj-hyphy-3.say: Ghost-ride the skateboard! Actually... don't. Hold on to it.

local-cheer-1.text: Yo! That's an EMB line right there.

local-cheer-3.text: Do it again, the seagulls missed it.

local-bail-3.text: Shake it off. Everybody slams at EMB.

muni-travel-1.text: This is an outbound train. Please hold on. Please hold on to anything.

muni-travel-2.text: Now arriving. Please exit on the left, or the right. We are not sure either.

muni-travel-3.text: This train is now in service. Mostly.

npc-shout-5.text: Get that thing out of here!

scooter-unlock.text: Ride started. Vantage thanks you for disrupting the sidewalk.

scooter-low.text: Low battery. Please end your ride soon.

scooter-empty.text: Battery depleted. Your ride has ended. Vantage appreciates your patience.

scooter-end.text: Ride ended. A receipt has been sent to an inbox you never check.
